title: STS-124 'bolt' in the payload bay was the ISS

tellings.quote: My brother Mark Kelly, a former NASA astronaut and also now a US senator, shared a story with me about an experience he had years ago that when he was commander of the STS124,

plain: Something that looked like a stray bolt floating in the cargo bay of a Space Shuttle in 2008 turned out to be the International Space Station seen in the distance. Scott Kelly passes on the story from his brother Mark Kelly, a former astronaut with NASA, the US space agency, and now a US senator, who commanded that shuttle flight, known as STS-124. He tells it on an episode where Michels debates a skeptic, as an example of a strange sight in space with an ordinary answer.
